description: US federal GSA schedule contractor dossier from GSA's official CALC+ API: the contractor's GSA contracts (contract number, schedule, SINs, start and end dates, small-business status), its awarded labor categories with hourly ceiling prices, and price statistics (min, median, average, max, percentiles) plus education, experience and worksite mix. Search by contractor name or a service keyword. Rates are ceiling prices, not invoiced prices. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

pages.description: Rate rows to scan for contracts, 1-5 pages of 20 (default 3)

vendor.description: Contractor name or keyword, e.g. booz allen, deloitte, cybersecurity
